audience.audience: The 25–44 household milk buyer (mother) currently buying a rival pack daily, in the South India core
audience.believes_now: Loose milk from the local vendor is fresh and cheaper; branded packs are 'processed' and I'm paying for a name. I don't distrust Heritage — I've just never had a reason to switch the daily habit.

channel.job: Get existing buyers to carry the two-milk-moments story — first tumbler, last glass — with the dawn footage spliced in

occasion.occasion: The first tumbler before school — the morning milk decision the 25–44 mother makes for her child
occasion.channels: TV (40s, 4am film) [lead] · OOH (highway + neighbourhood hoarding) · Digital pre-roll (20s)
occasion.hands_over: Recognition of the named farmer and the 'milked at dawn, on your table by morning' story in the South India core — so that when the promoter knocks and the chiller strip appears, the buyer already knows the face. Reach channels only; no proof of the functional claim, which has no sourced RTB.

measure.leading: Participation on the Reel/Short — shares, saves, and volume of UGC replicating the two-milk-moments format — plus sentiment split, tracked weekly
measure.lagging: Sustained share of positive brand conversation and organic mentions of #PureDoodhKiShakti carried by existing buyers rather than paid amplification
measure.would_tell_us_it_failed: Within the first 4–6 weeks: shares and saves stay flat and no organic UGC appears, OR sentiment tips negative on the purity/authenticity claim. Existing buyers are watching but not carrying it — advocacy isn't happening, and the format needs a real reason to share, not more paid push.

platform.name: The 4AM Promise
platform.idea: Heritage puts the same morning's collection on the pack — every carton is stamped with the date and dairy it came from that day, so purity is something a family can read, not just trust.

message.text: Social — Reel/Short, mother's POV: the two milk moments cut back to back — first tumbler before school, last glass before bed — with the farmer's dawn footage spliced between. Caption: 'The small, everyday choices are what quietly make them strong. #PureDoodhKiShakti #HeritageFoods'
message.note: Owns the bookend occasion in the feed's native language — the emotional message as a mother would actually say it, shareable because it's her routine, not an ad.
